description: Dex: open-source, Jev-compatible, non-autoregressive System 1 decision model on an Ettin-1B encoder

training.method: trained against strictly proper scoring rules: cross-entropy on the chosen option plus KL to the target probabilities; decision head trained from scratch
training.frozen: embeddings and the lowest 7 of 28 encoder layers (784M of 1.11B parameters trained)
